value.title: Episodio 01
value.synopsis: Wang Xiaoxiu trascorre delle giornate pacifiche con la sua amica d'infanzia Shen Yao, ma il capo di una banda di teppisti si invaghisce della ragazza e manda i suoi uomini a picchiare il giovane universitario. Quando Xiaoxiu cade in un fiume per sfuggire ai suoi aguzzini, trova un oggetto misterioso che gli donerà poteri incredibili.

value.title: Upgrade! Battle 5? Not to be feared!
value.synopsis: After being miraculously saved from the waters by the mysterious cube, Xiaoxiu realizes that it grants him superpowers, such as the ability to teleport. He will have to learn to master them quickly, because Jun and his gang are tenacious and determined to finish him off.

value.title: Melee! Is Wang Xiaoxiu still human?
value.synopsis: Feeling empowered by his newfound powers, Xiaoxiu decides to take on the North District gang to protect Yao. But when he arrives at the gym where Jun has arranged to meet him, he finds himself facing thirteen seasoned fighters against whom he has little chance of winning alone. Will his superpowers be enough?

value.title: Kidnapping? Demon present!
value.synopsis: Feeling empowered by his newfound powers, Xiaoxiu decides to take on the North District gang to protect Yao. But when he arrives at the gym where Jun has arranged to meet him, he finds himself facing thirteen seasoned fighters against whom he has little chance of winning alone. Will his superpowers be enough?

value.title: G.I. Joe Tower Climb: Wheel of Fortune
value.synopsis: Luo Yan, a young mafia boss, has taken Yao hostage to lure Qin Xigu, the man who saved her as a child. But the first to arrive on the scene is Xiaoxiu, and he's determined to save his girlfriend by any means necessary. Will he be able to defeat the highly trained mercenaries hired by Luo?

value.title: G.I. Joe Tower Climb: Monster Girl
value.synopsis: After defeating three members of the Martial Arts Alliance, Xiaoxiu is about to face two of its most powerful representatives, Jialin and Stone. Will he be able to defeat them and save Yao?

value.title: G.I. Joe Tower Climb: Funding for Explosive Fights
value.synopsis: Xiaoxiu is now very close to his goal. With Qin Xigu eliminating the penultimate obstacle in his path, all that remains is for the young man to defeat Mushan Chu. But the puppeteer is a devious and particularly tough opponent. Will he be able to defeat him and save Yao?

value.title: Being Tricked By A Black-Hearted Agent Into Working As A Bodyguard
value.synopsis: Xiaoxiu has lost Yao, the ability to speak to the cube, and any means of finding Luo Yan and Qin Xigu. Desperate, he is approached by a woman who claims to know where Luo is. Who is she? And what exactly does she want?

value.title: Rudra's Feast: Warriors and Golden Bells
value.synopsis: Xiaoxiu has been recruited by Yuqian Mu, head of the Superhuman Supervision Unit, to protect a VIP in exchange for information on Luo Yan and Qin Xigu. But his mission will prove even more complex and dangerous than his bodyguard contract suggested...

value.title: Rudra's Feast: The Real Employer
value.synopsis: After a genetically modified crocodile as an appetizer, Weibang Du serves his guests an even tougher second course. But Xiaoxiu notices some unusual behavior among his team, and things quickly escalate. What is Mr. Piao and the other bodyguards' real purpose at this banquet?

value.title: Rudra's Feast: The Strength of the Young Lady
